versions.changelog: Round 22-23 quality verified - descriptions fixed, tags updated

AWS Graph LITE v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides Bedrock AgentCore and LangGraph-based agent orchestration, with StateGraph workflow and containerized AgentCore Runtime as an HTTP service.
- Supports tools_condition auto-routing and ToolNode execution for streamlined tool invocation.
- Includes essential agentcore CLI commands for configuration, deployment, local development (hot-reload), invocation, and cleanup.
- Designed for fast, single-agent deployments and tool-calling scenarios; does not support persistent memory, multi-agent coordination, or API/Lambda integrations (upgrade required for these).
- Clear error/exception handling guides and known limitations included for a smoother setup experience.
